events.title: Demo Update: Clearer High Ground, No More Accidental Drops
events.summary: The demo has been updated.- High ground is now much easier to recognize at a glance.- Wide areas of high ground now have more slopes you can climb.- Added a "drop-down gauge": to jump down from high ground, hold the movement key for a moment. No more stepping off by accident and finding yourself unable to climb back.These changes are based on your feedback. Thank you!

events.title: Demo Update: Bigger Pockets and Faster Scavenging
events.summary: The demo has been updated.- The Seeker's Item Pocket and Material Pocket each gain 3 extra slots.- The Seeker now has a new Ability that raises the speed of scavenging Remains and Toolboxes to the maximum.These changes are based on your feedback. Please keep it coming!

events.title: Now at Steam Next Fest!
events.summary: ANIMITE -Echoes of the Chasm- is taking part in Steam Next Fest!The free demo takes about 20 minutes to play, in English, Japanese and Simplified Chinese.Explore in real time, and the moment something spots you, the floor you're standing on becomes a turn-based battlefield. When you call for extraction, the ecosystem you left alive comes after you.If you enjoy it, please add the game to your wishlist and let us know what you think in a demo review!

events.title: DEMO UPDATE: Opening movie added to the tutorial
events.summary: When you start the tutorial, an opening movie now plays to introduce the world of ANIMITE.

events.title: Demo Update: Simplified Chinese now available
events.summary: Simplified Chinese has been added to the languages available in the ANIMITE demo.Simplified Chinese support is also planned for the full game.

events.title: DEMO UPDATE：Improved the audio
events.summary: Greatly improved the audio during exploration.Added ambient sounds that change with your location and depth, and the reverb on gunfire, explosions, and other sounds now changes depending on where you are.Hit and elemental damage sounds, feeding enemies, and more now also reflect direction and distance, making it easier to tell where things are happening.Added footsteps for wet floors, wading through ponds, and struggling in water.Headphones recommended.

events.title: Demo update: combat fixes and improvements
events.summary: The demo has been updated.- Fixed a bug where combat would not end against enemies behind a wall- Ammo in your inventory is now sorted automatically- An effect now appears at the edges of the screen during combat, so it's clear when you're in a fightRestart Steam to get the latest version.ANIMITE will also be part of Steam Next Fest from October 19. Thanks for playing!
